seoTitle: Which Community Character Are You? Greendale Study Group Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Community test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jeff, Britta, Abed, Troy, Annie, Shirley or Pierce — with your full study group breakdown.
intro: Are you the smooth-talking cynic, the pop-culture genius, or the overachiever who's already colour-coded the study guide? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle friends, school and everyday chaos, and find out which member of the study group you are.

characters.name: Jeff Winger
characters.title: The Cool Cynic
characters.summary: Smooth, sarcastic and allergic to effort. You act like you don't care — but you're secretly the group's leader.
description: Like Jeff, you can talk your way out of anything. He was a lawyer until someone found out his degree was fake, which is how he ended up at Greendale.
You pretend to be above it all. But every time the group falls apart, it's you who ends up giving the big speech that pulls everyone back together.
You care way more than you let on. You'd just rather die than admit it.
characters.flaw: You're vain and you hate admitting you need other people.
characters.signature: A great jacket, a smirk and a Winger speech.
characters.clashReason: they'd find the laziest way to do everything

characters.name: Britta Perry
characters.title: The Well-Meaning Rebel
characters.summary: Passionate, principled and fighting for every cause. Your heart's always in the right place — even if things don't go to plan.
description: Like Britta, you care about the world. Every protest, every petition, every cause — you're there.
Things don't always work out. At Greendale, getting something slightly wrong became known as 'Britta-ing' it. But you keep trying anyway.
You're more fun than people think, and you're fiercely loyal to your weird group of friends.
characters.flaw: You can be preachy — and you 'Britta' things more than you'd like.
characters.signature: A protest sign, a leather jacket and a psychology degree she's very proud of.
characters.clashReason: they'd lecture you about your choices

characters.name: Abed Nadir
characters.title: The Meta Genius
characters.summary: You see life like a TV show — and you're usually right about where the plot is going.
description: Like Abed, you understand stories better than people. You know when something is a callback, a trope or a season finale.
You're a filmmaker at heart. Abed makes films about the group and sometimes predicts their lives before they happen.
You're unique, loyal and completely unbothered by being different. Cool. Cool cool cool.
characters.flaw: Sometimes you'd rather live in a story than deal with real life.
characters.signature: A camera, a pop-culture reference and "Cool. Cool cool cool."
characters.clashReason: they'd treat your life like a TV show

characters.name: Troy Barnes
characters.title: The Sweet Goofball
characters.summary: Fun, sweet and a big kid at heart. You were the cool jock once — now you're happily a nerd with your best friend.
description: Like Troy, you've grown into yourself. He was the high school football star, and he gave it up for a life he actually enjoys.
You love imaginative play, blanket forts and your best friend. Troy and Abed are one of TV's great friendships.
You're sensitive, emotional and completely sincere — and you cry more than you'll admit.
characters.flaw: You're a bit naive, and responsibility scares you.
characters.signature: A blanket fort, a secret handshake and a morning show with your best friend.
characters.clashReason: they'd never act like a grown-up

characters.name: Annie Edison
characters.title: The Driven Overachiever
characters.summary: Organised, ambitious and a little bit intense. You've already made the study guide — and colour-coded it.
description: Like Annie, you're a planner. Pens, highlighters, schedules — you've got a system for everything.
You're driven because you've had to be. Annie had a rough time in high school and arrived at Greendale determined to prove herself.
You look sweet, but you can be surprisingly ruthless when you want something.
characters.flaw: You're intense and you really, really need to win.
characters.signature: A pencil case, a perfect study plan and the Disney face.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you study when you'd rather not

characters.name: Shirley Bennett
characters.title: The Sweet but Savage Mom
characters.summary: Warm, motherly and deeply faithful — with a sharp edge you should never, ever underestimate.
description: Like Shirley, you take care of people. You bake, you give advice and you look after everyone like they're your own kids.
But don't cross you. Shirley's sweet voice can turn deadly in a second.
You're ambitious too. Shirley came back to school to build her own business, and she's savvier than people expect.
characters.flaw: You can be judgemental, and you hold grudges.
characters.signature: A plate of homemade brownies and a very sweet "That's nice."
characters.clashReason: they'd smile sweetly and judge you anyway

characters.name: Pierce Hawthorne
characters.title: The Out-of-Touch Old Timer
characters.summary: Rich, eccentric and desperate to be included. You say the wrong thing a lot — but you just want to belong.
description: Like Pierce, you want to be part of the group more than anything. You just don't always know how to do it.
You've got money and stories — Pierce's family made their fortune in moist towelettes — and you'll share both whether anyone asked or not.
Underneath the scheming and the bad jokes, you really do care about your friends.
characters.flaw: You say inappropriate things and you scheme when you feel left out.
characters.signature: A moist towelette, an old story and a very bad idea.
characters.clashReason: they'd say something offensive and not even notice

questions.text: It's the first day of a new class. You...

options.text: Sit at the back and work out how to pass with minimum effort
Arrive early with three colours of highlighter
People-watch and guess what everyone's story is
Introduce yourself to everyone and learn all their names

questions.text: Your friend group is falling apart over an argument. You...

options.text: Give a big speech that pulls everyone back together
Point out the real problem — and get ignored
Accidentally make it worse
Hide somewhere cosy until it blows over

questions.text: You're put on a group project. You...

options.text: Make a schedule and assign everyone tasks
Find the shortcut that gets it done with minimum effort
Do whatever your best friend is doing
Keep everyone in line. Firmly, but lovingly

questions.text: Someone disagrees with you on something you care deeply about. You...

options.text: Argue — then send them articles about it
Smile sweetly and pray for them
Understand exactly why they think that — and still disagree
Take it as a personal attack

questions.text: You mess something up in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Laugh it off. It happens a lot
Talk your way out of it smoothly
Apologise, then fix it perfectly
Cry. Just a little

questions.text: Your best friend wants to build something ridiculous together. You...

options.text: Yes! How big can we make it?
Help — and get way more into it than you expected
Offer to pay someone to do it
Roll your eyes, then secretly help

questions.text: A Sunday with nothing to do. You...

options.text: Sleep in, then the gym. You didn't get this body by accident
Watch a whole film series back to back, with commentary
A march in the morning, a bar in the afternoon
Church, then a whole afternoon of baking

questions.text: You decide to learn something new. You...

options.text: Take up an expensive hobby, then quit after one lesson
Dance classes. You've always had moves
A psychology night class. You'll be analysing everyone by week two
Cake decorating — then start selling them

questions.text: A friend asks you to recommend something to watch. You suggest...

options.text: An obscure film. You'll explain why it's perfect
Some old film you insist is a classic
A documentary that'll make them angry
Something romantic

questions.text: You're studying for a big test with friends. You...

options.text: Make colour-coded flashcards for everyone
Charm the teacher into dropping hints
Turn it into a game so it's actually fun
Bring brownies. Nobody studies on an empty stomach

questions.text: Your best friend is offered an amazing opportunity far away. It means leaving you behind. You...

options.text: Tell them to go. You'll adjust. Probably
Beg to come with them
Throw them an extravagant goodbye party. You're paying
Cry, then help them pack

questions.text: Someone in your study group cheated on the final — and the whole group's grade depends on it. You...

options.text: Report it. Rules are rules
Cover for them. What's one exam between friends?
Call them out in front of everyone. On principle
Pray on it — then make sure they confess
